name: mf-company-tax-rates-and-returns
description: French Saint-Martin company-tax reference for taxpayers already established as liable to local corporate income tax. Covers the ordinary rate, conditional small-company profit band, turnover and ownership tests, short-period adjustments, ordinary loss carryforward and separate return and balance-payment deadlines. Includes threshold and arithmetic examples using the official code consolidated through June 2026. Identifies an unresolved instalment-rate cross-reference rather than inventing a payment formula. Residence, territorial entitlement, special gains, group restructuring, incentives and full tax-base adjustments require separate analysis; this is a source-cited draft awaiting independent review, not comprehensive coverage.
